concerns.text: FR-004 requires computing `review_active_seconds` (time from first review comment to PR merge) but the referenced raw PR schema (`raw_prs.schema.yaml`) only provides `comment_count` and lacks any timestamp for the first comment. Without a `first_comment_timestamp` field the metric cannot be derived, making the requirement untestable as written.

FR-015 repeats the need for `review_active_seconds` as the primary metric, inheriting the same missing input problem identified in FR-004. The specification must add a field capturing the timestamp of the first review comment (or adjust the metric to use only available data).
